messages:
jordan_ae: Heads-up — GoliathHealth POC asked for a packaged compliance handoff. They want SOC2 + ISO excerpts, a signed pen-test attestation, and clarification on KMS separation for POC staging. They also asked whether we can run an external vuln scan mid-POC. Any blockers on delivering within 5 business days?

maya_se: Thanks for flagging. Quick Q: do they need KMS in their tenant (customer-managed) or just isolation assurances in our staging?

jordan_ae: Customer asked for customer-managed KMS for dedicated, but for the POC they said 'separate key material' is fine — they called it 'KMS separation'. Would like any network diagrams and a short note on HSM/KMS flow.

sam_solutions: We can provide an architecture excerpt and a short diagram. For POC staging we usually offer envelope-encryption w/ customer KEKs on dedicated, otherwise our KMS with ACLs. I'll draft language.

irene_compliance: I can do SOC2 and ISO artifacts extraction (scope, control mapping, test evidence links). For pen-test letter: we can provide our latest pentest attestation and sign a one-page letter confirming scope and date. Need to confirm whether they require red-team attestation vs 3rd-party report.

jordan_ae: They specifically mentioned 'red-team attestation' and an external scan schedule (monthly). Can we say we do weekly internal scans and can run a single external scan that we schedule with the vendor? Also they asked about ephemeral staging creds and how long pre-signed uploads are valid.

lee_ops: We can schedule a one-off external scan for the POC window, yes. For presigned uploads: default is 1 hour but we can generate a 24h presigned S3 link for evidence transfer. Example we can share: 
```
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/goliath/2026-03-xx --expires-in 86400
```
That should meet most vendor upload needs.

maya_se: Great. For network diagram: do they want VPC peering details? If POC is hosted, we'll show logical boundaries + egress IPs. If dedicated, we include subnet CIDRs and bastion access.

jordan_ae: They prefer hosted POC with dedicated tenancy, but still want assurance re: data-at-rest keys and dev access. Also pricing question: they asked if dedicated POC pricing has a 'burst' add-on and what the delta vs hosted is for 2-week trial. Can someone pull the quick price delta?

sam_solutions: I can pull a rough delta — typically dedicated POC runs ~2.5-3x hosted unit cost due to reserved GPU overhead. I'll DM exact numbers. We should avoid committing publicly in thread.

irene_compliance: Deliverables I can prepare in 48 hours: SOC2 extract (description + control mapping), ISO27001 scope excerpt, signed pen-test attestation template. I need the contact name and an address to put on the letter (legal signatory). Who has that?

jordan_ae: Contact is emma.k@ goliathhealth.com (CC'd on the deal). Legal wants signatory to be 'Goliath Health Inc.' — I'll drop full details in the CRM.

evidence-bot: Automated note: Evidence bundle template generated at /evidence-exports/goliath/3765432100/ — includes checklist.csv, soc2_excerpt.pdf, iso_scope.pdf, pentest_attestation_draft.docx.

lee_ops: I'll prep a short KMS flow doc (customer-managed options + our ACL fallback) and a simple network diagram. I can also generate a 24h presigned token for their uploads when you're ready.

maya_se: I'll assemble a 1-page summary for the SE-run of the POC (security controls, ephemeral creds lifecycle, scan cadence, price delta outline). Plan: drop bundle link + signed attestation into the customer's shared folder once irene signs.

jordan_ae: Perfect. Next steps: irene to produce artifacts (48h), sam to DM pricing, lee to generate diagram + presign option, maya to compile 1-pager. Goal: send to customer by EOD+2 business days. :thumbsup:

irene_compliance: Acknowledged. Will produce and queue the attestation for signature. If they need red-team detail we may require extra approval — will flag if so.

sam_solutions: DM-ing price delta now.

jordan_ae: thanks all — I'll update the deal notes and ping emma when the bundle is ready.
